Summarise the supplied source text in at most 100 words. Be concise and objective.
Report only information supported by the source. Attribute claims, opinions, and
projections to their authors or speakers, and preserve uncertainty and

summary: Senator Loren Legarda anticipates stronger Philippine-French cooperation on climate change and development as the countries mark 70 years of diplomatic relations. She said high-level visits had enhanced economic and political cooperation, climate action, sustainable development, and opportunities for cultural preservation. Climate change was a priority during French President François Hollande’s 2015 state visit, which included a forum, a joint statement and a visit to Yolanda-affected communities. Legarda and French envoy Nicolas Hulot helped craft the 2015 Manila Call to Action for Climate Change, signed by Hollande and Philippine President Benigno Aquino III.
